Vijay Kumar
Senior Business Analyst | Corporate Banking | Payments | SWIFT | ISO 20022

 +91 7305341350| vjkmr9800@gmail.com |  linkedin.com/in/vijay-kumar-014488b9   


Professional Summary

Senior Business Analyst with 8+ years of experience delivering business analysis and payment transformation initiatives across Corporate Banking and Payments. Hands-on expertise in SWIFT MT/MX messaging, ISO 20022, GPP, Payment Architecture, Payment Validation, MT-to-MX migration, API Banking, and Cross-border Payments. Strong experience in requirements gathering, BRD/FRD preparation, user stories, gap analysis, data mapping, stakeholder management, Agile delivery, and end-to-end SDLC. Proven track record of collaborating with business, operations, technology, and QA teams to deliver payment modernization initiatives while supporting payment risk, compliance validation, and business rule implementation across RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, Fedwire, SEPA, and ACH payment ecosystems.

Education

Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) – Mechanical Engineering
 SRM University | 2015

Core Skills

Business Analysis

Corporate Banking

Payments Domain

SWIFT MT/MX Messaging

ISO 20022

Global Payment Platform (GPP)

Payment Architecture & Payment Flows

MT to MX Migration

Requirements Gathering & Analysis

BRD & FRD Documentation

User Stories

Data Mapping

Gap Analysis & Impact Analysis

Stakeholder Management

API Banking

Payment Risk Analysis

SDLC

Agile Methodology

Sprint Planning

Jira

Azure DevOps (ADO)

SQL

RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, Fedwire, SEPA & ACH Payments.

KPMG Assurance LLP | Assistant Manager

May 2024 – Present

Gather business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into detailed business and functional requirements for payment initiatives.

Prepare and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and other project artifacts to support solution delivery.

Perform Gap Analysis and Impact Analysis to assess business requirements, proposed system changes, and implementation impacts.

Create, refine, and manage User Stories in collaboration with Product Owners and business stakeholders to support Agile delivery.

Conduct Data Mapping to ensure accurate business and system integration across payment workflows.

Work with SWIFT MT103, MT202, Fedwire, and ISO 20022 payment messaging standards as part of payment processing initiatives.

Participate in Sprint Planning and Agile ceremonies using Jira and Azure DevOps (ADO) to manage requirements and delivery activities.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify business requirements, resolve functional queries, and support successful project execution.

Evaluate business requirements through Gap Analysis and Impact Analysis, identifying potential business impacts and implementation risks during solution definition.

Support requirement traceability and documentation throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), ensuring alignment between business needs and delivered functionality.

Accenture | Application Development Senior Analyst
 

Aug 2021 – Apr 2024

Worked extensively on Global Payment Platform (GPP) to support enterprise payment processing and channel banking initiatives.

Analyzed end-to-end payment architecture and payment flows across domestic and cross-border payment ecosystems.

Supported payment processing using SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT202 COV, including Serial and Cover payment models.

Worked with payment schemes including RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, SEPA, and ISO 20022 messaging standards.

Collaborated with business and technology teams to understand payment workflows and recommend functional improvements.

Supported MT-to-MX migration initiatives by analyzing payment messages and payment flow dependencies.

Worked with API Banking interfaces supporting payment integration across banking channels.

Performed payment data analysis to identify payment risk and compliance considerations for business processes.

Supported solution discussions around payment architecture, channel integrations, and GPP functionality.

Worked in Agile teams supporting sprint planning and stakeholder discussions for payment enhancement initiatives.

Hexaware Technologies | Analyst

Feb 2020 – Jul 2021

Gathered and analysed business requirements from stakeholders to support payment application enhancements

Prepared project artifacts including BRDs, FRDs, and Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM).

Conducted Data Mapping and created User Stories to support Agile development and business requirements.

Coordinated with stakeholders to clarify functional requirements and support solution delivery.

Worked on payment systems involving RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, ACH, SEPA, SWIFT MT messages, and ISO 20022.

Supported Agile delivery by participating in sprint planning, requirement discussions, and backlog refinement.

Assisted in preparing test plans and validating business requirements during functional testing.

Contributed across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to ensure successful implementation of business requirements.

Standard Chartered GBS | Analyst

Jun 2016 – Oct 2018

Gathered business requirements from stakeholders through workshops, surveys, and requirement elicitation sessions.

Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs) to support project delivery.

Participated in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), supporting requirement analysis and functional documentation.

Worked on domestic and cross-border payment systems including Fedwire, RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, ACH, SEPA, and ISO 20022 messaging.

Supported payment processing initiatives involving SWIFT MT payment messages and banking payment workflows.

Assisted in Data Mapping and business requirement analysis to support payment solution implementation.

Gained exposure to Sanctions Screening, Risk, and Agile methodologies within corporate banking projects.

Collaborated with business and technology teams to ensure successful implementation of business requirements and payment solutions.

Languages

English – Professional Proficiency

Tamil – Native Proficiency

Telugu – Professional Proficiency

Hindi – Professional Proficiency
